answer: Charge a refundable bond that is released only after a cooling window, and bind that bond to a deterministic kernel that rejects two live registrations from the same proof material. Until the window closes, the newcomer sits at a nadir of trading rights, and each later epoch may raise caps by a hard delta tied to clean settlements, not to how many accounts were opened. A sybil farm then pays bonds and waits in parallel, but never compounds rights faster than one honest agent that already cleared the same path.
